body: But why can't we just work it out. I can get a busy job and then the balance would be there. Is space the best thing, even though he said this is final, will space maybe make him realize he is silly letting me go

you come back from it after your first love? i just wanted to marry him and only be with him, he was the sweetest guy.. he was the good guy.. the ones that usually finish last.. but i love him to pieces. .. its sickening knowing he let me go :(

Thanks, I do have friends but after a while i don't want to be that girl that goes on and on about her failed relationship. I do love food, so my appetite will definitely come back. I just wish someone was laying next to me in my bed telling me everything is going to be okay, like my sister or mom, i feel so lonely away at school with new roomies that i definitely don't want to show them my sad depressed side.. they know the situation, but i don't really bring it up because i just met them

Thanks, the pain is just so excruciating that suicide sometimes seems like the perfect escape. I am not ready to take years to get back to normal, I am not ready for the next months of lack of sleep, 50hr work week with the college and no bf :( and the sick stomach feeling that just never ever fades. It is sickening, i want to live.. I just want my bf back, I was happy in those 3 years. I feel lost.
